title: A risk model of gene signatures for predicting platinum response and survival in ovarian cancer.
summary: TCGA cohort (230 samples) supports an SVM platinum-response classifier and LASSO-Cox survival model, with GEO used for validation. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: Machine-learning signatures predict platinum response and survival in ovarian cancer.

evidence.tested: TCGA cohort (230 samples) supports an SVM platinum-response classifier and LASSO-Cox survival model, with GEO used for validation.
evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning signatures predict platinum response and survival in ovarian cancer.
